text.abstract: Adds an opt-in auto-commit that runs `git commit --only -- .yolo-twice` right away and then every 10 min when the folder changed, so staged work stays out of the commit. The state lives only in engine memory (`autocommit.ts`, `PUT /api/autocommit`, `yolo-twice autocommit on|off`), so it resets on engine restart and skips during merges, rebases or a detached HEAD, with the reason shown in a header button in `Header.tsx`; this is committed as 1a719fa with tests, typecheck and build passing. The button was missing in the browser only because the running engine predated the change, so restarting it fixed that, and the session then added live reload (a build id in the SSE `hello` frame plus a `build` event on UI rebuilds) and a `bun run dev` script that runs the engine and `vite build --watch` in parallel, both left uncommitted.
text.title: Engine-memory auto-commit of .yolo-twice via git commit --only, 10-minute interval
